basics.name: John Walley
basics.label: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior software engineer with 20+ years building applications, libraries, and tools for other developers, across frontend, backend, and infrastructure. Expert in TypeScript, React, Node.js, API design, and browser internals. Much of that time has gone into designing the abstractions other engineers build on, and into owning systems from architecture through to production. Comfortable setting technical direction, and still writes most of the code.

work.name: Cambridge Intelligence
work.summary: Senior engineer across developer experience, web applications, tooling, and high-performance graph visualisation SDKs, with a focus on architecture, developer productivity, and technical direction.
highlights: Co-designed and delivered a unified developer platform for multiple SDK products, consolidating X documentation pages, Y demos, and Z API reference pages into a single codebase and removing duplicated tooling across products.
Designed public APIs and reusable abstractions that make the SDKs easier to integrate and extend.
Transferred ownership of the Cloudflare-hosted website infrastructure from the Platform team to the development team, removing a cross-team dependency from every release.
Expanded Playwright end-to-end coverage with QA to approximately 90% of website functionality.
Migrated the existing content to the new platform with AI-assisted tooling rather than by hand.

Used AI-assisted workflows to migrate X documentation pages, Y demos, and Z API reference pages to the new platform, completing the migration in a fraction of the time a manual rewrite would have taken.

work.name: Mulberry House Software
work.summary: Independent consultancy building data-driven applications and open-source developer tooling. Sole engineer on every engagement, responsible for architecture, implementation, infrastructure, and product direction.
highlights: Author and maintainer of open-source React UI and data visualisation libraries, including [Allotment](https://allotment.mulberryhousesoftware.com/) and [Pennant](https://pennant.vega.xyz/), with 200,000+ weekly downloads and production use by the [Vega](https://vega.xyz/) trading network.

Delivered full-stack applications for clients in several industries, from requirements through to production and support: browser applications, Node.js APIs, cloud infrastructure, and deployment pipelines.

Built interactive applications and data visualisation tools for clients including home-renovation startup [Reno](https://www.renovatewithreno.co.uk/) and pensions technology company [Financial Canvas](https://www.financialcanvas.co.uk/).
Scoped and prioritised work directly with clients, usually with several engagements running at once.

work.name: Redgate
work.summary: Joined as a developer on Redgate's SQL Server deployment tooling, then moved into product management for a database deployment tool the company had recently acquired.
highlights: Built features for deploying database changes from CI/CD pipelines.
As product manager, ran user research and turned it into UX changes that increased adoption.
Added in-product analytics and used the data to prioritise the roadmap with UX and engineering.

work.name: Sungard
highlights: Worked on the framework that runs Sungard's financial risk analytics at scale.
Developed a tracing JIT compiler that ran existing C# financial models on GPUs without any rewriting.

work.name: Earlier Career
work.summary: Engineering and research roles spanning financial services, high-performance computing, scientific computing, and developer tooling.
highlights: High Performance Computing Developer at Fidelity, building computationally intensive systems for financial services.
Application Engineer at MathWorks, serving as UK technical contact for parallel computing tools.
Research Scientist at QinetiQ, working on multi-sensor fusion, object tracking, and defence systems.
